title: 第十五章 墨痕招祸
content_zh:
天亮了。

    雪停了，云压得很低，铅灰色的，沉沉地盖在北境这片白茫茫的大地上。

    江砚不知道，就在他凭空写出那把刀、烧穿那堵土墙的当口，有些东西，已经悄无声息地，变了。

    ——

    距沈家村三十里外，青石镇通往云中城的官道上，一个赶路的旅人，忽然勒住了脚步。

    那是个其貌不扬的中年人。一身洗得发白的灰布短打，背着个半旧的货郎担子，担子上挑着些针头线脑、胭脂水粉，看着，和这条道上来来往往的行脚货郎没什么两样。

    可这货郎，眼神不大对。

    寻常货郎，眼里装的是营生，是哪个村哪个寨能多卖两文钱。这人的眼睛，却像鹰隼一样,扫过荒原、扫过远山、扫过铅灰的天，扫的是些旁人压根看不见、也不会去看的东西。

    他叫什么，没人知道。这条北境道上认得他的人，只唤他一声“赵货郎“。

    可在另一些更隐秘、更见不得光的圈子里，他还有个别的称呼——

    嗅迹的。

    赵货郎抬起头,鼻翼极轻微地动了动，像头闻到血腥味的兽。

    他“嗅“的，自然不是寻常的气味。

    天地之间，有一种东西，逆着常理，违着自然。寻常人对它毫无知觉，可在他这样天生异禀、又经年累月专司此道的人眼里——它就像漆黑荒夜里，骤然燃起的一簇火光，刺眼，扎心，藏都藏不住。

    他们管这东西，叫“墨痕“。

    是某种“逆天造物“留在天地间的痕迹。

    赵货郎在这北境道上走了快二十年，专替几位“贵人“，嗅这世间一切不该出现的异样。卫家那帮玩“摹刻“的，邪门一脉那些夺人手艺的……天底下凡是动了这等不入流玄机的，留下的那点腥气，多半逃不过他的鼻子。

    可这么多年，他嗅到的，大多是些陈年旧痕，淡得几乎散尽；要么，就是卫家那些伪术拓物留下的、有形无神的“假痕“——闻着，总带着一股子死物的、生硬的味道。

    今天这一缕，不一样。
content_en:
It's dawn.

    The snow has stopped, and the clouds are very low, leaden and gray, covering the vast white land in the north.

    Jiang Yan didn't know that just when he wrote the knife out of thin air and burned through the earth wall, something had quietly changed.

    ——

    Thirty miles away from Shenjia Village, on the official road from Qingshi Town to Yunzhong City, a traveling traveler suddenly stopped in his tracks.

    He was a middle-aged man with a plain appearance. Wearing a short coat of white washed gray cloth, he was carrying a half-worn peddler's burden, which carried some needles, thread, rouge and gouache. Looking at it, he looked no different from the peddlers who came and went on this road.

    But this salesman’s eyes were wrong.

    Ordinary salesmen only care about making a living. Which village can sell goods for two cents more. This man's eyes, like those of a hawk, swept over the wasteland, the distant mountains, and the gray sky. They swept over things that others could not even see or look at.

    What his name was, no one knew. People on this northern road who recognized him only called him "Zhao Merchant".

    But in other more secretive and shady circles, he also has other names——

    Smell trace.

    Merchant Zhao raised his head and his nose moved slightly, like a beast smelling blood.

    What he "smelled" was certainly not an ordinary smell.

    There is something between heaven and earth that goes against common sense and goes against nature. Ordinary people have no awareness of it, but in the eyes of a person like him who is naturally gifted and has specialized in this skill for many years - it is like a sudden burst of fire in a dark night, dazzling, heartbreaking, and impossible to hide.

    They call this thing "ink mark".

    It is a trace of some kind of "creation against heaven" left in the world.

    Merchant Zhao has been walking along the Northern Road for almost twenty years, sniffing out all the strange things in the world for a few "noble people". Those from the Wei family who play "carving", those from the evil sect who steal people's craftsmanship... Anyone in the world who uses such low-level secrets will probably not be able to escape his nose with the fishy smell left behind.

    But over the years, most of what he smelled were old traces that were so light that they were almost gone; or, they were tangible and spiritless "fake traces" left by the Wei family's pseudo-artworks - the smell always had a dead, raw smell.

    This one today is different.
